description: Source code for CreateBundleTargetGenerator class, responsible for generating build targets related to bundles in a build system, including setting directories, product types, scripts, and other bundle attributes.

classes.name: CreateBundleTargetGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating build target configurations for bundle targets, including setting directories, product types, scripts, and other bundle attributes.

methods.name: DoRun
methods.description: Main method executing the target generation process, calling various Fill* methods to set up bundle properties.

methods.name: FillBundleDir
methods.description: Sets a directory property for the bundle, verifying its path and ensuring it is within the output directory.

methods.name: FillXcodeExtraAttributes
methods.description: Populates extra Xcode attributes from the scope into the target's bundle data.

methods.name: FillProductType
methods.description: Sets the product type of the bundle if specified.

methods.name: FillPartialInfoPlist
methods.description: Sets the partial Info.plist file for the bundle, resolving its path.

methods.name: FillXcodeTestApplicationName
methods.description: Sets the Xcode test application name if specified.

methods.name: FillPostProcessingScript
methods.description: Sets the post-processing script file for the bundle.

methods.name: FillPostProcessingManifest
methods.description: Sets the post-processing manifest file, requiring the script to be defined.

methods.name: FillPostProcessingSources
methods.description: Sets the list of post-processing source files, requiring the script to be defined.

methods.name: FillPostProcessingOutputs
methods.description: Sets the outputs for post-processing, validating their paths.

methods.name: FillPostProcessingArgs
methods.description: Sets the arguments for post-processing script execution.

methods.name: FillBundleDepsFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter for bundle dependencies based on label patterns.

methods.name: FillTransparent
methods.description: Sets whether the bundle is transparent.
